script.title: Narrated Video With Zero API Keys

voice_performance.performance_intent: A competent engineer showing the shortest path. No enthusiasm markers, no sell. The self-referential close only lands if the preceding 40 seconds sound utterly ordinary.
voice_performance.energy_curve: Flat and low through s1-s3, a single lift on s4 when the registry flips, settling to a quiet landing on s6.
voice_performance.pause_policy: 0.5s between every section; 1.4s closing hold after s6 so the final terminal state is readable after narration ends.

provider_notes.piper_tts: Timings below are MEASURED, not estimated — each line was synthesized and probed with ffprobe. Re-synthesis with identical text, model, and sentence_silence reproduces them to the frame.

metadata.script_mode_note: No source recording exists (synthetic_terminal). Narration is authored for TTS, and TTS is confirmed available — this script does not depend on a provider that might not be there.
metadata.timing_provenance: Each section's duration was measured by synthesizing the line with piper en_US-lessac-medium and probing with ffprobe. Measured speech total 41.51s; layout adds a 0.30s lead-in, five 0.50s inter-section gaps, and a 1.40s closing hold = 45.31s.

interaction_map.note: Design rule: >=2s of empty terminal before anything types.

interaction_map.target: echo "Two installs, no keys." | piper -m en_US-lessac-medium --data-dir ~/.piper/models -f vo.wav

interaction_map.note: Typed faster than the others because it is long; still legible, and the eye only needs the shape.
Lands under the s6 narration line. This is the whole video in one frame.

speed_plan.note: No source footage means no speed ramps. The equivalent lever is per-command typeSpeed, listed in interaction_map.
speed_plan.type_speed_range: 0.028-0.045 s/char — slower for the two commands the viewer should actually copy, faster for the long verification one-liner.
speed_plan.no_dead_time: Every pause step exists to reach a narration cue, not to wait on a process.

metadata.callout_policy: One pill on screen at a time, each fired at the moment its event completes. Six across 45s.
metadata.zoom_note: None. A synthetic terminal is authored at final resolution — every character is already crisp at 1080p, so the pipeline's usual crop-legibility risk does not apply.

pronunciation_guides.phonetic: written as 'Piper' in narration — the hyphenated package name reads badly aloud
never spoken; appears on screen only

intelligibility_check.method: Every synthesized line was transcribed back with faster-whisper (base) and diffed against intent.
fixes_applied: 'Three tools flip to available' came back as 'Free tools' — rewritten, then rewritten again to name the actual on-screen numbers ('zero of ten configured, to one').
'Two installs' came back as 'To installs' in s6 — rewritten to 'That is two installs, and no keys.', which transcribes correctly.
intelligibility_check.residual: 'faster whisper' occasionally returns as 'Taster Whisper' and 'wave file' as 'way file' under the base ASR model. These are recognizer errors on clean audio, not synthesis defects — captions are burned from this script's text, never from ASR, so they cannot reach the screen.

metadata.verbatim_output_policy: Every output line was captured from a real run on this machine. pip output came from a clean throwaway venv install; the Successfully-installed line is elided with a trailing ellipsis because the true line lists 30 packages.
